_comment: Chronos Sphere (requested 2026-09-14 as Chrono). Legendary Arcane, two-handed, INS+WLP, Very Low damage (Staff chassis +6 -> +2), Dark, melee, no drawback (user ruling). Passive: a basic attack that deals damage gives the target 1 Chronostasis; at 3 it loses them all and one action (registry stack_deny). Granted spell Time Dilation (10 MP: Swift, or Slow + 1 Chronostasis) is NOT in this spec -- priced on paper.
